original_prompt: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing Lambda-based API metrics (invocations, errors, throttles, average duration).
Parameters:
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lambda-api-health'
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Dashboard.
  DefaultFunctionFilter:
    Type: String
    Default: '*'
    Description: Default filter for Lambda FunctionName variable (e.g., *, api-*, my-func).
Resources:
  LambdaApiHealthDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Ref DashboardName
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "start": "-PT6H",
          "periodOverride": "inherit",
          "variables": [
            {
              "id": "fn",
              "type": "query",
              "label": "Lambda Function",
              "default": "${DefaultFunctionFilter}",
              "definition": "SEARCH('{AWS/Lambda,FunctionName} MetricName=\"Invocations\"', 'Sum', 300)"
            }
          ],
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Lambda Invocations",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "legend": { "position": "bottom" },
                "metrics": [
                  [ { "expression": "SEARCH('{AWS/Lambda,FunctionName} MetricName=\"Invocations\" FunctionName=\"${fn}\"', 'Sum', 60)", "id": "e1" } ]
                ]
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Lambda Errors",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "legend": { "position": "bottom" },
                "metrics": [
                  [ { "expression": "SEARCH('{AWS/Lambda,FunctionName} MetricName=\"Errors\" FunctionName=\"${fn}\"', 'Sum', 60)", "id": "e2" } ]
                ]
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Lambda Throttles",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "legend": { "position": "bottom" },
                "metrics": [
                  [ { "expression": "SEARCH('{AWS/Lambda,FunctionName} MetricName=\"Throttles\" FunctionName=\"${fn}\"', 'Sum', 60)", "id": "e3" } ]
                ]
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Lambda Duration (Average, ms)",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "legend": { "position": "bottom" },
                "metrics": [
                  [ { "expression": "SEARCH('{AWS/Lambda,FunctionName} MetricName=\"Duration\" FunctionName=\"${fn}\"', 'Average', 60)", "id": "e4" } ]
                ],
                "yAxis": {
                  "left": { "label": "ms", "min": 0 }
                }
              }
            }
          ]
        }
Outputs:
  DashboardName:
    Description: Name of the created CloudWatch Dashboard.
    Value: !Ref DashboardName
  DashboardResource:
    Description: CloudFormation logical resource ID.
    Value: !Ref LambdaApiHealthDashboard
